comments.rawMarkdown:
I have a theory. And it explains the public/hidden variance/divergence. I made changes to the harness that would have given more time to games that hit L2 or higher. It got me to ~13 (up from 7.6) on the public data, it works. But it was a slight digression on the hidden data. The best explanation I have for this is that if your solver is at ~3.5 or less, you're mostly not solving any level 2 or up of the hidden games. The arc people have said the hidden games are harder so we don't truly have any representative training data (beyond subsetting the hardest of the open 25). 

I am guessing going forward, I need to focus harness development on synthetic games designed to be "harder than the public games" in the remaining month and a half. And I'm sharing this because in the spirit of competition, it's about the only thing that makes any sense to me at this point.
